technique_name: What were the causes of World War I?
description: The causes of World War I include widespread militarism and imperialism, nationalism and a desire for power and prestige, and a complex system of alliance between the European nations. Militarism was a prominent factor in the growing tension, and nations strove to increase their military power and position of influence.
